target: PM12 S/N1803 physical channel12 ADC A/B
leases: PM12,Atmel,Kasli plus ESP32/CPLD leases on BOTH Optiplex and station2
integrator: GPA7=HIGH; T1 pulls Integrator_PDn low by schematic; latch/pin HIGH read back
adc_input: MAX4053 A/B selectors HIGH,INH LOW; external input connected to ADC A
notes: Voltage axis is requested DAC voltage, not a calibrated DMM measurement.
Four-sample pattern subtraction is a statistical comparison, not proof of ADC-only noise.
No MCU/FPGA/CPLD programming, resets, EEPROM writes or PLL writes.
subsequent_source_changes: Added PGOOD recheck before GPIO setup and independent zero-volt DAC parking on errors; successful acquisition path unchanged.
